name: billboard-planner
description: Turn a vendor's billboard list into a live satellite map your whole team can read. Pins, photos, rates and distances in one shareable HTML file.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @billboard-planner/core && npm run build -w @billboard-planner/cli
scripts.build:example: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.js build examples/aaj-swift-nh48/plan.yaml
